starwars-sd.aviso.semSpaceDragon: Star Wars SD: the Space Dragon module is disabled. This supplement's classes and powers use its rules — enable it in Manage Modules.
starwars-sd.settings.regrasDeNave.dica: Sets the table's DEFAULT rule, used by every new ship. Tactical: the Supplement's tactical combat, with a maneuver dial, secretly planned maneuvers, Overload and defence dice that cancel damage dice. Book: Space Dragon §10.6, with no grid and no dial — defence is the CP, and only small ships trade the CP for a saving throw via evasive maneuvers. Any single ship can use the other rule via Configure Sheet, with no reload.
starwars-sd.settings.temaDaNave.dica: The ship sheet has its own palette and does not follow a dark-mode module on its own. On automatic it follows the page (the theme-dark class, used by Foundry and by most such modules) and, failing that, the operating system preference. A per-viewer preference: it applies only to you.
starwars-sd.settings.movimentoDaNave.dic: Hex: as the Supplement writes it — the ship moves straight through the cells and turns at the end. Arc: the X-Wing Miniatures Game mechanic — it follows the curve, turning along it, and stops where it would bump instead of skipping cells. Not just looks: the final position changes.
